# S3.3 — the Stage-3 evaluation kernel (`hh-eval`) and the out-of-process benchmark adapters (`hh-bench`): metric catalogue as distributions, compliance metrics, `compare` + the three benefit kinds + `equivalence_run` + `render_scorecard`, deterministic oracles, pass^k/intervals/tails, fault/perturbation profiles, the loss-report export; adapters A/C/D/E with `materialize`/`expose`/`collect_submission`/`grade`, `separate` verifiers, the infra detector, parity reports, L4 (R-2.9.2 · R-2.9.4⁰ᵇ)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5h.2 (metrics; `compare`) · §5h.4
(`R-2.9.4⁰ᵇ` benchmark adapters)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/046_S3.3__metric-catalogue-and-compare.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.9.2 · R-2.9.4⁰ᵇ**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s3.2` (stacked) · **Stage:** 3 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (all checks hermetic)
**ADR:** `docs/adr/ADR-0277-s3.3-eval-kernel-and-bench-adapter-rulings.md`

## Summary

**Missing is `n/a`, incomparable is a refusal.** `hh-eval` lands the
metric catalogue as `MetricDeclaration` registry rows whose cells are
*distributions*: per-task `(c, n)` counts (pass^k/pass@k stay
recomputable), point + interval with a named `EstimatorSelection`,
quantiles and tails. Observability, participant-class and detector
admissibility are checked per metric per run — an inapplicable run
enters `excluded{class | observability | n/a:<reason>}`, never a coerced
0 (AC-R-2.9.2-3/-5). Non-scored outcome classes follow the metric's
`outcome_class_policy` — `budget_exhausted` is `count_as_failure`
inside the declared capability denominator; `infrastructure_failure`,
`oracle_failure`, `refused`, `cancelled` are counted beside the
headline, never merged in (AC-R-2.9.2-5). Veto-tripped runs are
excluded and counted beside (`vetoed`/`vetoed_successes` —
AC-R-2.9.2-9); a `judged` value never feeds a deterministic-only
headline metric (AC-R-2.9.2-13).

**`compare` matches budgets or refuses.** Arms with unequal hard
limits, exploratory runs, environment/family/split drift or a split-hash
mismatch are typed refusals (`UnmatchedBudget`, `ExploratoryRun`,
`EnvironmentDrift`, `SplitHashMismatch`, …) — the `budget_match`
record rides every `ComparisonReport` (AC-R-2.9.2-2; CC9). The three
benefit kinds gate on their preconditions: `artifact_benefit` requires
held-out splits, zero eval-phase search spend and a
`SplitAssignmentRecord` that predates the earliest
`transitioned{to: proposed}` (`LeakedSplit` — AC-R-2.9.4-8);
`equivalence_run` is three-valued with margins drawn only from the
`PreRegistration` (caller margins refuse — OQ-113). The contrast
estimator answers "does V help M₁ more than M₂" over a
2×2×≥3-task fixture with an interval (AC-R-2.9.2-1).

**The scorer boundary is real.** Oracles run per run over a boundary —
`(end-state handle, ledger cursor, artifact refs) → [MetricValue]` —
with the `hh-eval-oracle` binary producing byte-identical values to the
in-process path (AC-R-2.9.2-11). `ScorecardReport` records
`metric_registry_version`, `price_table_version`, oracle ids and the
results watermark; regeneration is hash-equal (`idp/1` over the
canonical report — AC-R-2.9.2-12). Portability cells gate on ≥ 2
snapshots from ≥ 2 families + ≥ 1 held-out level, else
`n/a{not_run}` (AC-R-2.9.2-10); strata render per stratum, pooling
without annotation refuses, a retired suite renders `guarded`
(AC-R-2.9.4-7/-11). Compliance metrics (activation / following /
pass-when-activated) compute from ledger events
(AC-R-2.9.2-7); `opacity_dynamic` derives per call from
`context.assembled` (AC-R-2.9.2-8).

**Adapters integrate suites; they do not author them.** `hh-bench`
lands the `benchmark_adapter` contract — `declare`, `discover`,
`import_task`, `materialize`, `expose`, `collect_submission`, `grade`,
`export`, `parity` — with fixtures for A (coding-terminal /
Harbor-like), C (search-research / SWE-bench-like), D (structured-tool /
τ-bench-like) and E (persistent multi-episode / AgentDojo-like). All
adapter calls run out of process through `hh-bench-adapter`
(newline-canonical-JSON over stdio), matching
`ClassRecord.locality = out_of_process`. The environment model is
three-surface — participant/search, verifier/held-out,
instrument/grader — held-out material never enters a participant root,
`grade` reaches it only through the verifier handle, and
participant-plane callers are refused `collect_submission`/`grade`
(`expose` on a verifier handle refuses; `separate` verifier isolation is
the default when submissions exist, `shared` only where the family
declares it). A tampering fixture scores `fail` under `separate`; an
empty/non-finite reward is `oracle_failure`; a broken image is
`infrastructure_failure{container_unavailable, environment}`
(AC-R-2.9.4-4). `FamilyUnsupported{missing}` refuses at `materialize`
when the handle's declared support misses a required capability; the
`structured_tool` family runs containerless through a `kernel_internal`
executor (AC-R-2.9.4-12). Tag-only image identity lands in `unpinned[]`
and caps `claimed_level` at R1/R3 — foreign version strings ride
`version_label`/`foreign_digest` claims only (AC-R-2.9.4-6). `FsEnv`
refuses network modes it cannot enforce rather than claiming advisory
enforcement; the `benchmark_egress` veto trips on an agent-phase egress
deny outside the allowlist (AC-R-2.9.4-5). `ParityReport` requires an
`artifact_benefit` comparison and carries the per-task replay verdicts
(AC-R-2.9.4-3 machinery).

**Boundary ruling (ADR-0277):** the §5h.2 ops land as pure
records-in/records-out Group L ops — `lab.eval.compare`,
`lab.eval.equivalence_run`, `lab.eval.render_scorecard` — while the
store-backed `lab.analysis.*`/`lab.results.*` surface stays S3.4a–c's
(the CLI `compare report|scorecard` verbs already target those staged
ops). `hh eval catalogue|compare|scorecard|equivalence|loss-report`
verbs expose the kernel over record files.

## Deferrals / gaps (honest)

- The **executable halves against real foreign suites** — a full
  manifest import exercising L1/L2, per-adapter parity runs against
  real foreign runners, the mini-SWE-agent-class stratum-C round trip —
  await GATE-G2's `benchmarkSet` (progress notes appended to
  DF-S1.24-1 / DF-S1.24-2; the rows stay OPEN).
- `lab.analysis.*` / `lab.results.*` store-backed services: S3.4a–c.
- Judge calibration/independence (AC-R-2.9.2-14), hosted participants
  over the same adapters (AC-R-2.9.4-9/-10), `export` to foreign
  formats: Stage 4 rows per the spec's C1/C2 staging.
